# Version 4.151.0 (Unreleased)
> **Graphite GPU and Nano Server fonts**

## Highlights

This development snapshot adds Graphite GPU backends (Vulkan, Metal, Dawn) and FreeType font support for Nano Server. The new Graphite rendering engine gains complete bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn via a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package. Nano Server gains FreeType-based font rendering. Memory safety fixes land for SKPixmap and SKImage, and performance improvements reduce allocations in SKData streaming, string encoding, and runtime effect uniforms.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn** — New bindings expose the Graphite rendering backend across all three GPU APIs — Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn — giving consumers access to the next-generation Skia renderer. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Async pixel readback via RequestReadPixels** — SKImage and SKSurface gain a backend-neutral RequestReadPixels API for asynchronous GPU-to-CPU pixel transfer without blocking the GPU pipeline. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package added** — A new convenience package wraps Vulkan via the Silk.NET bindings, simplifying Vulkan context setup for SkiaSharp applications. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))

## Bug Fixes

- **Use-after-free in SKPixmap.ExtractSubset and With* fixed** — The root pixel source was not kept alive through the derived pixmap's lifetime; native memory could be freed while still in use. ([#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Memory leak in SKImage.Create raster failure path fixed** — A CoTaskMem pixel buffer was leaked when the SKImage raster creation path failed; the buffer is now correctly freed on failure. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Platform

- **FreeType font support on Nano Server** — Nano Server, which has no GDI or DirectWrite, can now load and render fonts using FreeType, resolving a long-standing gap for containerized Windows workloads. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Containerized test coverage: Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, Nano Server** — CI test legs now validate SkiaSharp on container-hosted Azure Linux, Alpine (musl libc), and Windows Nano Server targets, catching portability regressions earlier. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))

## Engine

- **Upstream Skia m151 stability patches applied** — Multiple upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix merges keep the bundled engine current with Google's stable branch. ([#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537))
